missing_evidence: Inventory-side trace or log confirming the rejected configuration value is the direct cause of the 503 responses
Confirmation that the invalid cfg-015 revision is the active configuration on the 3.3.5 deployment
candidates.statement: Inventory is rejecting configuration values (9 ERROR log occurrences, 14 configuration_rejections, error_rate 0.1, 503s) after a 3-minute-old deploy to 3.3.5 with configuration_revision cfg-015 marked configuration_valid=false. Gateway traces show the inventory call erroring at 915ms, consistent with checkout degradation originating in inventory configuration.
candidates.uncertainty: Deployment record alone does not establish causation; the link between the invalid config revision and the 503s is inferred, not directly observed.

report.explanation: Inventory shows configuration_value_rejected errors, elevated configuration_rejections and error_rate, and a recent deploy with configuration_valid=false; gateway traces show the inventory call failing. Other services' metrics and logs are healthy, so the bounded candidate is bad configuration in inventory. Deployment record alone is not treated as proof of causation.
